As Yy (YY) Stock Value Declined, Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk LTD Has Upped Holding by $1.01 Million; L & S Advisors Has Lifted Holding in Home Depot (HD) as Stock Declined
May 12, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
L & S Advisors Inc increased its stake in Home Depot (HD) by 57.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. L & S Advisors Inc bought 16,833 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 46,050 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.73M, up from 29,217 at the end of the previous reported quarter. L & S Advisors Inc who had been investing in Home Depot for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $219.37 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.68% or $3.15 during the last trading session, reaching $190.31. About 5.36 million shares traded or 5.76% up from the average. The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) has risen 18.94% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.39% the S&P500.
Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd increased its stake in Yy Inc (YY) by 103.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd bought 8,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.91% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,500 shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.98M, up from 8,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd who had been investing in Yy Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.48 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.15% or $1.19 during the last trading session, reaching $102.56. About 1.94M shares traded or 8.17% up from the average. YY Inc. (NASDAQ:YY) has risen 125.46% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 113.91% the S&P500.
Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd, which manages about $121.83M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Netease Inc (NASDAQ:NTES) by 1.99M shares to 12,500 shares, valued at $4.31 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
